scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/schema && tsc -p packages/editor && tsc -p packages/frontend/tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/frontend/tsconfig.spec.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/functions --noEmit && tsc -p packages/e2e --noEmit && tsc -p packages/rules-tests && tsc -p infra/worker --noEmit
scripts.test:unit: vitest run --project schema --project editor --project functions --project worker && npm run test -w packages/frontend -- --watch=false
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/frontend && npm run build:functions
